subject: Exec weekly: OKR pulse, QBR prep & prioritized asks
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, michael.grant@redwood.ai
Cc:
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Exec weekly: OKR pulse, QBR prep & prioritized asks

Team —

Quick weekly pulse ahead of QBR week. I’m consolidating the exec packet and want to call out the most important wins, risks, and asks so we don’t scramble Friday. Please read and respond inline where you own an action.

Wins
- Hosted API uptime improved to 99.97% last sprint; infra reported lower tail latency on 32k token runs.
- Redwood Optimize pilot (Customer: Acme Health) reduced per-session cost by ~18% in early testing.

Risks (priority order)
1) QBR deck: we’re missing a crisp cost-savings slide and a 1-pager about our Dedicated sizing assumptions — customers will ask.
2) SOC 2 evidence: still pending a couple of logs for on-prem ingest that Compliance will need for the audit window.
3) Dedicated capacity forecasting: Capacity numbers for May are incomplete; potential SLA exposure if we miss projected growth.

Asks / Action items (owner — due)
- Monica — update the Acme cost model with actual pilot numbers and a sensitivity table (Mar 24 EOD). Attachment: exec-weekly-agenda-20260318.pdf contains the QBR table of contents.
- Michael — confirm Dedicated capacity commitments vs. committed pool (provide headroom, Mar 22 noon PT).
- Laura — consolidate security evidence checklist and confirm timeline to close the remaining logs (Mar 23 COB).
- All — review the QBR slide list in the Drive link and flag any missing content by Mon 3/22 5pm PT.

Notes for the QBR narrative: focus on predictable economics (per-session cost + tail-latency SLOs), reliability improvements, and our rollout plan for Private (on-prem/VPC) for regulated customers.

Attachments: exec-weekly-agenda-20260318.pdf (agenda + slide outline).

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Thanks Markus — quick notes inline.

> Risks (priority order)
> 1) QBR deck: we’re missing a crisp cost-savings slide and a 1-pager about our Dedicated sizing assumptions — customers will ask.

Agree. Add: a short appendix showing model variants + quantization tradeoffs — customers will want to see concrete options for cost/latency.

> Asks / Action items (owner — due)
> - Monica — update the Acme cost model with actual pilot numbers and a sensitivity table (Mar 24 EOD).

Monica — can you include both token-level and session-level views? Also tag which numbers are from hosted vs. dedicated to avoid confusion in the QBR.

> - Michael — confirm Dedicated capacity commitments vs. committed pool (provide headroom, Mar 22 noon PT).

Michael — please call out any blockers (procurement, infra limits). If we can’t provide headroom, we should propose a fallback plan (e.g., burst pools or routing to compatible variants).

> - Laura — consolidate security evidence checklist and confirm timeline to close the remaining logs (Mar 23 COB).

I’ll own this, will reach out to Compliance and Infra to get a definitive list of the two missing logs and expected ETA.

Also: recommend we add a single slide with the customer ask and our ask (what we want the customer to commit to) — simple BAU + runway ask.

—Laura
Laura Bennett | Chief of Staff, Strategy & Ops
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Thanks all for the quick turn. Short follow-up and next checkpoints: 

1) Monica — received your note and attachment. Good framing — two asks for you: (a) please add a one-line sensitivity summary we can put on the main slide (less than 30 words), and (b) call out any data quality caveats we should be explicit about. Confirmed deliverable: final XLS + one-slide narrative by Mar 24 EOD.

2) Michael — please confirm capacity headroom by Mon Mar 22 12:00 PT. If you anticipate constraints, propose an automatic fallback we can include in the QBR appendix.

3) Laura — appreciate owning the security checklist. If Compliance needs anything from Product (e.g., logs, diagram updates), loop in Dev Patel and cc me.

QBR timeline (firm)
- Mon Mar 22 17:00 PT — final slide flag deadline (owners confirm done or need dev help)
- Wed Mar 24 17:00 PT — consolidated deck to exec review (I’ll compile)
- Fri Mar 26 — QBR meeting (internal rehearsal Thurs 3/25 2pm PT)

I’ll draft the single-page executive summary once I have Monica’s sensitivity line and Laura’s security closure ETA.

If you need to escalate resource support, let me know before EOD Mon.
